Gan Ainm, X:3

Prompted by Gian Marco’s discussion, I looked out my 48-year-old cassette of a group of Swedish musicians playing this waltz in O’Dea’s Bar, Ennis, over the week of the 1976 Fleadh. These are the notes they played. I’m musing whether that first figure, around the high A, may make it a Scandinavian relative of The Cliffs of Moher or The Garden of Daisies…

↳ Posted by Jerry O'Donnell on June 5th, 2025.

I’ve seen this more than a handful of times just called ‘Finnish Waltz’.

Re: Finnish

Finally… found it called ‘Pelimannin Aamu’ - composed by Antti Vesterinen (1908-198i) from Finland
(https://www.stefanlinden.se/L/vals%20Pelimannin%20Aamu%20fi.pdf) - includes chords.
I’m also seeing it other places as this name, now.
Played here by Jean-Pierre YVert.
